bundle.shortDescription: Find what is filling your disk, and clear it safely.
bundle.longDescription: Cleanup scans a folder or a whole drive, shows where the space actually went, and helps you clear it without guesswork. Duplicate detection verified by content hash, a storage map, one-at-a-time review, and a Quick Clean pass for the caches Windows rebuilds anyway. Everything runs locally. Nothing is uploaded, nothing is deleted without your say-so, and every move can be undone.
